parsed.note_claim: This video is from the 2022 Kerch Crimean Bridge explosion, not the King Fahd Bridge.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the specific date, location, and details of the 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion, substantiating the note's claim about the video's source event.
